chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq who said:

I was at Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) one night when al-Ahwal came in to see him. There overcame him an extreme state of humility and submissiveness. Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to him: 'What is the matter with you?' And he began conversing with him until he returned to normal. Then he said to him: 'How do you debate with the people?' He said: 'So he described to him how he argues against the people, and I did not memorize that from him.' Then Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Debate them using such and such.'

key_terms.التَّذَلُّل: Humility, lowliness, or abasement in presence of the Imam
key_terms.الْأَحْوَلُ: Al-Ahwal, a known companion of the Imams
key_terms.بِكَذَا وَكَذَا: Such and such (indicating specific points or arguments)
key_terms.يُخَاصِمُ: To debate, argue, or contend with others

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq teach al-Ahwal about debating with people?
ai.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the Imam’s pedagogical approach to refining the rhetorical strategies of his contemporaries, specifically al-Ahwal, who was known for his dialectical skills. By instructing him on specific arguments, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) demonstrated how theological truth could be effectively communicated through tailored discourse, a practice deeply rooted in the Shia tradition of *taqiyya* and intellectual engagement. This incident underscores the importance of not just possessing knowledge, but mastering the art of its presentation to diverse audiences.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/174] Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh b. Nusayr from Muhammad b. Isa from Yunus from Ismail b. Abd al-Khaliq who said:

I was at Abi Abdillah’s عليه السلام place one night when al-Ahwal came in to see him. There overcame him [al-Ahwal] an extreme state of humility and submissiveness [in the presence of the Imam]. Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to him: what is the matter with you? and he [the Imam] began conversing with him until he [al-Ahwal] returned to normal. Then he [the Imam] said to him: how do you debate with the people [what points do you use]? he [Ismail] said: so he [al-Ahwal] described to him how he argues against the people and I did not memorize that from him, then Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: debate them using such and such [points].
